subject: general
question: Which of the following conversions are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __1 L = 1 dm3 and 1 mL = 1 cm3**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 1 L is equal to 1 dm³.
 
• 1 mL is equal to 1 cm³.
 
• These are standard metric conversions in the SI system.
 
• 1 liter (L) is equivalent to 1000 milliliters (mL).
 
• 1 decimeter cubed (dm³) is equivalent to 1000 cubic centimeters (cm³).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Incorrect Options:**

 
 
• 1000 L = 1 dm³ and 1 mL = 1000 cm³ (Incorrect as 1 dm³ = 1 L).
 
• 1000 L = 1 dm³ and 1000 mL = 1 cm³ (Incorrect as 1 mL = 1 cm³).
 
• 1 L = 1000 dm³ and 1 mL = 1000 cm³ (Incorrect as 1 L = 1 dm³).
